title: Momcozy S12 Pro Quick Wearable Breast Pump, 24mm Flange, 2 PC, White
bullets: Faster & More Efficient Pumping. Powerful -292 mmHg suction delivers up to 28.2% faster pumping and 6% more milk output than the previous model. (*Based on Momcozy Lab data)
DoubleFit Hybrid Flange. Innovative soft silicone meets firm PP for a secure, leak-free seal. BPA-free and skin-friendly for all-day comfort.
Simple Setup & Quick Cleaning. Only 4 parts and 3 easy steps. Designed with a smooth, one-piece funnel for easy rinsing and drying.
Thoughtful Design for Ease & Safety. Ergonomic grip tabs & dual-use flange cover for easy handling, intuitive digital screen, and 30-min auto shut-off for worry-free sessions.
Long-Lasting Power & Quiet Use. 1350 mAh battery supports up to 8 sessions (240 min) on one charge. ≤46 dB whisper-quiet for discreet pumping anywhere. It supports everyday baby essentials needs.
